programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Salta Diya
programme.desc: A rich man's wife and a thief's wife simultaneously give birth to twin sons, from which two of them get exchanged. Years later, an unexpected event leads them to swap places once again.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Pithamagan
programme.desc: An imposter befriends a social outcast convicted in a drug-peddling case in prison. However, when they are released from jail, they get entangled in a local drug lord's vicious scheme.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Shivam
programme.desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Pataakha
programme.desc: Badki and Chhutki are two sisters who constantly keep fighting with one another. However, when they get married, they understand each other's importance and build a stronger bond.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Simon Daniel
programme.desc: An archaeologist embarks on a treasure hunt in an old estate, which his now missing friend had started. His mission to find his friend and the treasure does not come without the horrors of the place.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Last Vampyre
programme.desc: 1993. Drama. Director: Tim Sullivan. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke & Roy Marsden. Sherlock Holmes investigates strange and tragic happenings in a village where an unusual man resides.

programme.title: The Big Trees
programme.desc: 1952. Western. Directed by Felix E. Feist. Stars Kirk Douglas, Eve Miller & Patrice Wymore. A timber baron sets his sights on California's redwood trees but faces conflict with a Quaker colony.

programme.title: Fort Algiers
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Lesley Selander. Stars Yvonne De Carlo, Carlos Thompson & Raymond Burr. In northwest Africa, a tribal leader tries to stir up a rebellion against the ruling powers.

programme.title: About Bread
programme.desc: 1938. A short reel about the process of making bread from importing ingredients, to baking and distributing. Plus, the nutritional benefits for everyone that bread can provide.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Account Closed. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dennis Price & Helen Backlin. Harry Brandon gambles and fails on get rich quick schemes, until his wife is accused of theft and there is a finding fee.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Impractical Joker. 1966. Stars Adam West & Cesar Romero. The Joker vandalises a number of key objects around Gotham. Commissioner Gordon calls Batman and Robin to solve the enigmatic clues.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker's Provokers. 1966. Stars Adam West & Cesar Romero. While Batman and Robin attempt to free themselves, The Joker plans to take over Gotham City using a time machine and hallucinogens.

programme.title: Bombay Waterfront
programme.desc: 1952. Directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley, Patricia Dainton and Peter Gawthorne. Follows Temple's efforts to aid the police in solving a series of gruesome murders.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Directed by Peter Maxwell. Stars Patrick Holt, Emrys Jones & Honor Blackman. An inspector strives to solve the mystery of an artist's dead wife. The artist becomes the main suspect.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: Manhunt. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Trapped on an island owned by Prince Erik, a man who enjoys hunting prey, Tell's careers appears to be at the end.

programme.title: Object Z
programme.desc: The Meteor. 1965. Stars Margaret Neale, Denys Peek & Trevor Bannister. Scientists around the world announce that a meteor will hit Earth in six weeks.

programme.title: William at the Circus
programme.desc: Lost Cinema Serial - Episode 1. 1948. Stars William Graham, Garry Marsh & Jane Welsh. William Brown begins to devise a plan to secure more pay and shorter hours for schoolboys.

programme.title: Venture Adventure
programme.desc: 1941. A short film encouraging young men to enlist in the Army Training Corps, which was set up to train men in aviation skills, navigation and general duties for entry into the RAF.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: False Faces. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Bill Walsh. A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent.

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Pete and Petro. 1949. Stars: Clayton Moore, Jay Silverheels & Sheila Ryan. Pete and Pedro don't like working, until the Lone Ranger persuades them to help an attractive young woman save her ranch.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Lost City. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Highland Fling. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Alexander Gauge & Hugh McDermott. King Richard sends Robin Hood and Friar Tuck on a mission to Scotland to collect a debt in the form of gold.

programme.title: Target Earth
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by Sherman A. Rose. Starring Richard Denning. A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it.

programme.title: Gift Horse
programme.desc: 1952. Director: Compton Bennett. Stars Trevor Howard, Richard Attenborough, Sonny Tufts. In 1940, the Captain of an old Royal Navy destroyer struggles with his crew, as well as the Nazis.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1965. The Material Witness. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & John Carlin. A young executive plots to replace a firm's manager, and turns him in to police as a drunk driver. (S1, E09)

programme.title: Call Northside 777
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Henry Hathaway. Stars James Stewart, Richard Conte & Helen Walker. A Chicago reporter looks into an old murder and realises the man jailed for the crime is innocent.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The King's Shilling. 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Ken Wynne. Swiftnick helps two lads who have been tricked into joining the King's army. The recruiting officers double back to get revenge.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Liars. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Joseph Furst. Maigret travels to a coastal village to investigate the murder of the postmistress, with the schoolmaster being the main suspect.

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: Bertie. 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Denis Lill & Ann Firbank. As Lillie acquires more admirers, her old friends see less of her, and she begins planning for the end of the season.

programme.title: Unfaithfully Yours
programme.desc: 1984. Comedy. Directed by Howard Zieff. Stars Dudley Moore, Nastassja Kinski & Armand Assante. An orchestra conductor believes that his wife is cheating on him and concocts a plan to murder her.

programme.title: Confessions from a Holiday Camp
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Directed by Norman Cohen. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Bill Maynard. Holiday camp employees enjoy their summer celebrations until a new manager arrives to spoil the fun.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. We meet a Spanish siren with castanets, meet Finland's biggest slappers, Lolo dives deep down with her snorkel and one man goes down in medical history.

programme.title: Yanky Panky
